title: Design System: Mera Bhavishya – Mera Nirnay

display.purpose: The programme name painted on the home wall; road picture inline. Phones: clamp(2.9rem, 14vw, 4.2rem).

headline.purpose: App page h1 and home section titles (to 3rem).

sign.purpose: Painted signs, number-line step names, road names, stop numerals.

title.purpose: h3/h4, card and option titles, in the text face.

lead.purpose: The one sentence under a page name (1.125rem in app page headers).

body.purpose: All running text, Hindi and English.

label.purpose: Hints, table heads, breadcrumbs, meta lines.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system is flat: no elevation shadows at rest or on hover.

shadows.name: stop-knockout
shadows.purpose: Paint, not elevation: a solid ground-colour ring that knocks a number stop out of the ink line (3px, and #fff inside white panels).

shadows.name: footer-stripe
shadows.purpose: Paint, not elevation: the ink stripe under the footer's 12px geru dado.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for colour, press and pop-in transitions.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Drawn movements: number-line stroke, hero shutter.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background and border colour changes on hover/selection.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Pressed buttons, chips, options (signs .98). Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: number-line-draw
motion.value: line scaleX 0→1 900ms ease-in-out; stops scale .6→1 + fade 350ms, delay 250ms + 180ms × index; ticks fade 300ms
motion.purpose: Home four steps, drawn once on entering view (IntersectionObserver). Reduced motion or no script: fully drawn.

motion.name: hero-shutter
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0)→0 1100ms ease-in-out; image scale 1.12→1 1400ms ease-out
motion.purpose: The road picture opening inside the painted name. Reduced motion: shown open.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: single column, 16px gutter, vertical number line, wall chart hidden.

breakpoints.name: top-nav-hidden
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: home top-line links hide; menu carries navigation.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: grids to two columns, hero stacks, number-line stroke hidden.

breakpoints.name: sidebar
breakpoints.purpose: min-width: green 248px sidebar; below it the 56px green phone bar.

breakpoints.name: top-nav-trim
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: home top line shows three of five links.

print.sheets: Two A4 portrait sheets per student, printed as a set: participation certificate + career profile. @page margin 0; each sheet zooms down to the printable area so the set is always exactly two pages.
print.palette: print-ink #111 frame, rules and text; geru #9b3a24 accents (certificate subtitle, school name, fit figures); RIASEC tiles; legible in black and white.
print.type: Khand headings, Anek Devanagari text, pt/mm units.

narrative.overview:
The portal is painted like the wall of the student's own Haryana government school: a yellow limewash upper wall, a brick-red geru dado along the bottom with an ink stripe painted along its top edge, signboard lettering, a painted number line, a blackboard in a wooden frame, green painted woodwork. Every view, the chrome included, sits on that wall. Content goes on white notice panels pinned to the limewash. The student should recognise it as the wall they walk past every day, not as a website template.

This world was chosen by the user. It refuses two things by name: the gov-design-system template look (blue headers, grey cards), and the colourless "ink on white, one blue" studio page this portal shipped before. The paint is flat and matte. Corners are square, there are no shadows, and nothing is glass or a gradient. Depth comes from paint layers: a white panel on limewash, a geru band under the wall, a green frame around the app. Density is a school notice board: plain, legible, large type in Hindi first, every action a painted sign big enough for a thumb.

Product truth keeps the world honest. The Haryana Government emblem stays, on a limewash plate where the chrome is green. Pictures are illustrations made with Figma AI, and the footer says so. They never pretend to show real students or schools. The printed report card has to survive an ordinary black-and-white school printer.
keyCharacteristics: Limewash ground everywhere, with white notice panels and a 1px wash-line border.
Geru marks the one thing to do (the primary button) and the steps of a sequence (number-line stops). Leaf green paints the chrome, the data and the student's own choices. Ochre marks where you are.
Khand signboard lettering for headings and numbers in both scripts, Anek Devanagari for everything read.
Square painted corners (3px), flat paint, no shadows at rest.
The painted number line is the signature. Any numbered sequence or progress runs along it.
Wall devices: the geru dado with its ink stripe, the framed blackboard, the green wall, the six-roads wall chart.

rules.name: The No Blue Rule
rules.body: No blue is used anywhere: not in links, focus, charts, chrome or the theme colour. The world has no blue pigment. Blue is what the refused template and the previous direction were made of.

rules.name: The Three Pigments Rule
rules.body: Each pigment has one job. Geru: act, or a step in a sequence. Green: the frame and the student's own data and choices. Ochre: where you are. Do not swap them for variety.

rules.name: The Painted Letters Rule
rules.body: Khand is used only for things painted on the wall: h1 and h2, the programme name, signs, step names and numerals. Running text, h3/h4, buttons and form text stay in Anek Devanagari.

rules.name: The Zero Tracking Rule
rules.body: Painted headings keep letter-spacing at 0 in both languages. Tightened tracking belonged to the previous direction and breaks Devanagari matras.

rules.name: The Flat Paint Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows, blurs, glass or gradients at rest or on hover. If something needs to stand forward, give it a different paint (white on wash, ochre on green, ink border on white).

rules.name: The No Pill Rule
rules.body: Nothing is pill-shaped. Square paint is used everywhere, and circles are kept for numbered stops.

dos: **Do** paint every surface on limewash (`limewash`), and put readable content on white notice panels with a 1px wash-line border.

**Do** use geru for the primary action and for numbered stops; leaf green for the chrome, data bars and the student's selections; and ochre for "you are here" (the active nav item, wall-chart numerals), always with ink on it.
**Do** end every app page header with the dado stripe: a 12px geru band with a 4px ink stripe.
**Do** put any numbered sequence or progress on the painted number line: an ink line with geru stops.
**Do** keep corners at 3px everywhere, and circles only for number stops.
**Do** set h1/h2, signs and numerals in Khand with letter-spacing 0, and everything read in Anek Devanagari.
**Do** switch the focus outline to white on green, geru and blackboard grounds, and keep it a 3px ink outline elsewhere.
**Do** keep the Haryana emblem on a limewash plate wherever the chrome is green.
**Do** label every picture as a Figma-AI illustration and ship its provenance sidecar.
**Do** make printed sheets in print ink with geru accents, legible in black and white.
**Do** give every motion a reduced-motion state that shows the finished picture (line drawn, shutter open).
donts: **Don't** use blue anywhere: links, focus, charts, chrome or the theme colour.
**Don't** use drop shadows, blur, backdrop-filter glass or gradients; the wall is flat paint.
**Don't** use pill or rounded shapes for buttons, chips, toggles or panels.
**Don't** set ochre as text, or put text in white on ochre; ochre is a field for ink.
**Don't** set running text, buttons or form text in Khand.
**Don't** apply negative letter-spacing to headings in either script.
**Don't** colour the RIASEC types or data from outside the wall palette.
**Don't** present illustrations as photographs of real students, schools or colleges.
